L1 `import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'` -> DROPPED: react-router-dom is DOM-only and forbidden in native output (rule 4). The back affordance becomes a native <Pressable> that routes the web `to="/vehicles"` target through a new optional `onNavigate(href)` navigation-shell bridge prop (the UsageCard / RecentActivityFeed / AlertRulesPage / OnboardingPage / ErrorDisplay precedent). When no shell callback is wired the press is a safe no-op (`onNavigate?.('/vehicles')`) while the control stays visible — the documented native-safe unavailable state for browser routing (rule 7).

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'` -> DROPPED for a native-safe `useNativeTranslationFallback()` returning `t(key, fallback) => fallback` (no RN i18n runtime; the sibling MotorSection / InputCommandTile precedent). L3 `import { ArrowLeft, Power } from 'lucide-react'` -> DROPPED: lucide-react is browser-only SVG, forbidden in native output (rule 4). Each glyph is rendered via the native SemanticIcon glyph vocabulary, precomputed once as consts: ArrowLeft -> getSemanticIconDefinition('back').glyph ('<', the canonical left/back arrow), Power -> getSemanticIconDefinition('power').glyph ('PW').
